allowedSourceMaterial.overview: New Yorkers Skip Donahue and Harry Monroe have no jobs and no prospects, so they decide to flee the city and find work elsewhere, landing jobs wearing woodpecker costumes to promote the opening of a bank. When their feathery costumes are stolen and used in a bank robbery, they no longer have to worry about employment — they're sent to prison.

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: Packet contains no explicit pacing signals; medium pace is inferred from genre and runtime rather than direct evidence.
Only funny is grounded; the crime/prison premise could justify exciting or suspenseful for some viewers, but packet support is insufficient.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Framed by thieves who pinched their bird suits, can two utterly mismatched city slickers survive life behind bars?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Down on their luck in New York, pals Skip and Harry seek a fresh start out of town dressed as promotional woodpeckers, only to find themselves framed for a bank heist and shipped off to a maximum-security penitentiary.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, funny, and breezy, delivering an easy-watch buddy misadventure with steady comic momentum.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Sidney Poitier, this classic 1980 buddy comedy spins absurd mistaken identity and wrongful imprisonment into effortless, lighthearted laughs.
